name: Westview Academy
source:
[i]A talented young man joins "Westview Academy", one of the nations best schools, it is known for its spectacular sports facilities and its music program. In Westview Academy, he'll make tough decisions and have unique experiences surrounded by many new friends and different environments, how will your story go?[/i]

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/TakoYuh]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
[i]一位才华横溢的年轻人加入了“Westview Academy”，这是全国最好的学校之一，它以其壮观的体育设施和音乐课程而闻名。在西景学园，他会做出艰难的决定，也会有独特的经历，周围有很多新朋友，不同的环境，你的故事将会如何发展？[/i]

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/TakoYuh]Patreon[/url]]
